text:
La Gazzetta dello Sport
Juventus nightmare
Another embarrassment: Spalletti apologises, McKennie accuses
Genoa only need 30 minutes; the Bianconeri are now 11 points behind the top spot
There’s Inter, where’s Milan?
Chivu at the top, Amorim collapses: Thrilling derby on Saturday.
The Nerazzurri win in Venezia with two own goals. Cisse not enough for the Rossoneri. Bologna ahead with Mbangula.
New San Siro unveiled today; it has a stunning design.
Napoli restart from Monza: Hojlund scores, but Lobotka gets injured.
Malagò-Galliani: A two-horse race
Corriere dello Sport
Mbangula knocks Amorim down
Hat-trick from the striker and Bartesaghi own goal: Ruben turned upside down. Useless brace from Cisse. Palladino flies: 10 points in five games. Chivu catches Lazio at the top thanks to own goals in the dying minutes. Lauberbach’s 1-0 ruled out by millimeters.
Lucio hits rock bottom
Third loss in nine games
Juve nightmare: another flop. Beaten by De Rossi.
An embarrassment, with defence in disarray. Genoa score with Ehizibue and Baldanzi. Spalletti risks: rumours about Sousa and Pioli. Sunday’s game against Napoli is decisive.
Napoli start again: poker to Monza
First half going uphill: Hojlund and Varela’s goals. Redemption in the second half with Politano, Rafa Marin and KDB. Lobotka injured.
Tuttosport
Triple Mbangula: Milan shocked
The former Juventus winger eats the devil, and a Cisse brace wasn’t enough. First league loss for Amorim and boos. The Nerazzurri win in the dying minutes with two own goals, but took risks before. Venezia asked for a penalty and protested a foul in the build-up to the 1-0. Chivu: ‘We were lucky, thanks Provedel.’
A horrendous Juventus humiliated by a great Genoa: Spalletti in a tilt
Horrifying
De Rossi humiliates his mentor Lucio: -11 from Inter and Lazio. Ehizibue and Baldanzi make Marassi celebrate. Bianconeri are shocking in their passivity in challenges and the passes they give to opponents, with a slower intensity compared to the Rossoblu. Carnevali, Massara and Ferrero’s faces say it all. It’s time to think. The coach: ‘I apologise to the fans. Poor and no fight.’
Hojlund wakes up: Overwhelming Napoli
Abate’s fury: ‘Stop giving goals away.’
digest_he:
עיתוני הספורט המרכזיים באיטליה מדווחים הבוקר על המשבר הקשה שפוקד את יובנטוס לאחר תבוסה נוספת, הפעם לגנואה, שהותירה את הקבוצה במרחק של 11 נקודות מהפסגה. המאמן לוצ'יאנו ספאלטי התנצל בפני האוהדים על ההופעה החלשה וחסרת הרוח הלחימה, בעוד שמועות החלו לרחף לגבי עתידו.

במקביל, הדיווחים מתמקדים במאבקי הצמרת בסרייה אה, כולל הניצחונות של אינטר ונאפולי, וההפסד של מילאן. נאפולי חזרה לעניינים עם ניצחון מוחץ מונזה, אך סבלה מפציעתו של סטניסלב לובוטקה. במקביל, נחשף העיצוב החדש והמרשים של אצטדיון סן סירו.
